# [2.225.0-dev.10](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v2.225.0-dev.9...v2.225.0-dev.10) (2024-05-12)

> [!NOTE]  
> Merged inotia's repo. A lot of patches have been merged, don't worry, patches are not deleted, they are still there. Only Whitelist in `Overlay buttons` and `Hide player buttons background` were removed from "unique patches" based on [this list](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/discussions/446). If you noticed that something's missing, let me know. If you need those removed features, let me know here and in that case, refrain from updating for now.

### Features

* Refactor and match ReVanced and inotia ([5b4dca0](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/5b4dca03970f887f6caaf3da072ff77276754a61))
* **YouTube - Visual preferences icons:** Added more icons ([9dd62ce](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/9dd62ceacaeca8ab1b0b7c7c221e2cebc19a563f))
